“Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah…

translations.web: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
translations.bsb: he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
translations.kjv: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
translations.asv: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man inhabited, Which were ready to become heaps;
